title: Service-Call Charge on Northgate Protect Repairs: In-Home Trips and Depot Bench Work
content:
A service-call charge is added to the authorized repair value on a Northgate Protect single-item plan, by the item category of the covered order line as the customer's Northgate Store and Online Orders records show it:

| Item category of the covered order line | Service-call charge |
|---|---|
| In the tier's in-home service categories | In-home trip charge, $65.00 |
| Computer, tablet or mobile phone outside those categories | Depot bench charge, $40.00 |
| Any other item | Nothing |

The tier's in-home service categories are, on the Standard tiers, major appliances, fitness equipment, furniture and TV and home theater, and on the Accident tiers, TV and home theater.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical items)

- A refrigerator on a Standard plan is a major appliance in that tier's in-home categories: $65.00.
- A television on an Accident plan is in that tier's in-home categories: $65.00.
- A laptop or a mobile phone is outside every tier's in-home categories: $40.00.
- A blender, a small appliance outside the in-home categories, carries nothing.
